fullDescription: Super Travel Premium Editorial System is a high-contrast luxury design language characterized by bold geometric typography and a sophisticated muted palette. Utilizing League Spartan exclusively, it blends an editorial layout with modern interactivity. Featuring a warm off-white (#fdf8f3), charcoal (#262626), and dusty rose (#e4a4bd) color scheme, the system employs heavy 15vw headlines, grayscale-to-color image transitions, and staggered portfolio grids. Ideal for high-end travel, boutique architecture, luxury concierge services, or fashion editorials, it utilizes a signature cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) easing for a 'heavy' yet fluid premium feel.

structured.summary: A premium editorial design system defined by massive geometric typography, a muted warm-and-charcoal palette, and a high-end fashion magazine layout featuring staggered grids and scroll-triggered reveals.

style.description: The style is anchored by League Spartan typography (weights 100-900), utilizing tight tracking for headlines and ultra-wide 0.2em-0.4em tracking for metadata and navigation. The palette uses #fdf8f3 as a base with #f5f0eb for section layering, #262626 for primary text, and #e4a4bd for delicate accents. Animations are slow (1s) and use the cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) 'premium' curve. Images remain grayscale by default, revealing color and scaling 1.08x on hover.
style.prompt: Apply a premium editorial aesthetic using 'League Spartan' font. Background: #fdf8f3. Text: #262626. Accent: #e4a4bd. Headlines: Massive (up to 15vw), black weight, line-height 0.8, letter-spacing -0.05em. Incorporate specific lowercase italic accents in #e4a4bd within headlines. Navigation: 80px fixed glassmorphism (rgba(253, 248, 243, 0.8) with 12px blur). Buttons: Pill-shaped, #e4a4bd background with #262626 text, 10px uppercase tracking 0.2em. Images: Grayscale (100%) by default, 16px-24px border-radius, transitioning to full color and scale(1.08) over 1s using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). Animation: Scroll-triggered reveal-up (translateY 40px to 0, opacity 0 to 1) with 1s duration.

layout_and_structure.description: A 12-column grid system with significant whitespace and an asymmetrical balance. Sections alternate between warm-off-white and slightly darker cream backgrounds to define transitions.

prompts.prompt: Fixed top bar, 80px height. Left: Brand name in 2xl black uppercase. Center: Nav links in 10px black uppercase, 0.2em tracking. Right: Pill-shaped CTA button (#e4a4bd). Use backdrop-filter: blur(12px) and a subtle 1px bottom border rgba(38, 38, 38, 0.05).

Full viewport height. Split 12-column layout. Left (7 columns): Headline 15vw, line-height 0.8, including one word in lowercase italic rose (#e4a4bd). Below headline, a 2xl body text block (70% opacity charcoal) and a text-link CTA with a 2px rose border-bottom. Right (5 columns): Vertical rectangular card (aspect 4/5) with 24px corner radius and grayscale image. Include a floating 160px circular badge in #e4a4bd with '01' italic text, offset from the card with a 4s vertical bounce animation.

Background #f5f0eb. Headline 8xl black tracking-tighter. 3-column grid with 1px charcoal borders (0.1 opacity). Each card: 40px padding, transitions from #fdf8f3 to #e4a4bd on hover. Icons: 6xl size, rose color, switching to charcoal on hover. Titles: 3xl bold uppercase.

Staggered 2-column grid. Even-numbered items offset 100px downwards. Images: 3:4 aspect ratio, 16px radius, grayscale-to-color hover. Hover overlay: 96px black circle with white 'View Case' text (10px, uppercase). Caption: Category in 10px rose tracking-ultra, Title in 4xl bold, sub-tags separated by bullets.

Background #f5f0eb. 12-column layout. Left 5 columns: Large brand name and mission text (xl). Right 7 columns: 3 sub-columns for links. Headers: 10px rose uppercase with a 1px solid rose underline offset by 8px. Bottom bar: 1px top border, copyright text 9px charcoal at 30% opacity.

special_ui_components.description: An animated circular callout used to denote curated content.
special_ui_components.prompt: 160px diameter circle, background #e4a4bd. Centered content: 4xl italic number '01' and 8px black uppercase label with 0.4em tracking. Animation: 'bounce-slow' (translateY -5% to 5%) over 4s with ease-in-out.

special_ui_components.description: Interactive image revealing internal CTA and color.
special_ui_components.prompt: Parent container with overflow:hidden and 16px border-radius. Child image: grayscale(100%), transition 1s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1). On hover: scale(1.08) and grayscale(0%). Overlay: Centered black circle (w-24 h-24) appearing with opacity 0 to 1 on hover, containing 'View Case' in white 10px black weight tracking-widest.
